name: Fire29 low painted growth control
description: Create a seamless calm ground-fire loop around this exact tile, preserving the supplied sprite completely still and unchanged. Add low broad painted orange-yellow tongues rooted in the existing flame strokes along both rear diagonal edges and corners. Their contours should slowly grow outward and recede at different phases, visibly spilling8to12pixels beyond the tile edge in this256px source while staying low. The flame grows by adding connected fire at its tip, never by bending or warping the sprite. Match the soft mottled watercolor fire texture and muted warm palette. Steady burning: no flash, ignition, spark, detached particle, smoke, jet, glow pulse, sharp horn or tall column. No lights or whole-sprite tinting. Keep the floor fixed. Transparent outside fire. Loop2seconds at16fps; show complete growth and return without a seam jump. Keep the canvas256x256 if possible.
